import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
plt.xkcd()
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5,3.5))
# core facets
import numpy as np
xs=[-8,-4,0,4,8]
ys=[0,3,4,3,0]
ax.plot(xs+[8,-8], ys+[ -6,-6], 'k-')
for x,y in zip(xs, ys):
    ax.plot([x-2,x+2],[y,y],'r-')
    ax.text(x, y+0.5, 'taxel', fontsize=6, ha='center')
# skin drape
tx=np.linspace(-9,9,100)
sy=5+0.5*np.cos(tx/2)
ax.plot(tx, sy, 'b-')
ax.text(0,6,'skin moves',ha='center',fontsize=8)
ax.text(0,-3,'core fixed',ha='center',fontsize=8)
ax.set_aspect('equal'); ax.axis('off')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('sketch.png')
